summary: Core Information Audit engine and Question generation (Epic #218 / Feature #221) - MCP tool skeleton + tests + registration

entries.migration_impact: New MCP tool `plate_perform_information_audit` (and future gh plate surface) available for agents. Initial stub returns proposed Questions grounded in Wiki Goals page + platform defaults (per #220 model and #223 contract). Full open-ended discovery, refinement, provenance, CLI, and integration in subsequent commits for this Feature. Downstream adopters will inherit via platform.
entries.agent_notes: Call plate_perform_information_audit (start with dry_run=true) to discover Informational Goals and receive well-formed Question proposals (title/body with provenance/related_goals per #220). Output is designed to feed Curiosity/Q&A and Contemplation flows. See designs #220 and #223 for the exact model and 10 behavior rules.
